SEC. 841. CHANGE IN DATE OF SUBMISSION TO CONGRESS OF SELECTED 
                        ACQUISITION REPORTS.

    Section 2432(f) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``45'' the first place it occurs and inserting ``30''.
